title: I love Gacha Games but hate the monetization - so I'm building my own dream game
author: Vaveidan
selftext:
Hey Community,

it's a long road already and still is far from being finished but the groundwork stands. I'm building my dream Gacha Game without the hundreds and thousands of dollars you need to invest into them.

ChronicleIdle is the game I put all my free time into currently and this is a first very early preview of that game. It's no way near being finished but we are slowly getting there.

It's inspired by Gacha classics like Raid Shadow Legends, Infinite Magicraid, Age of Magic and countless other Gacha Games I played over the last few years.

Just wanted to share a quick preview of it here, maybe there are some more gacha lovers out here! :)

And good luck for your own games! <3
